recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36009 unless the Patient Care work group later reopens the broader AdverseEvent.status model question.
issue_request: FHIR-36009 was an Applied/Persuasive Patient Care change request for R6 asking to append a clarification to AdverseEvent.status comments: the adverse event status may be determined by clinical-trial assessment timing and is not necessarily the same as condition status.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged implementation commit f0ef42412d98ab9aa5bf86e350afa22787e7c44d (J#36009 AdverseEvent.status comments), merged via PR #3083, updated source/adverseevent/structuredefinition-AdverseEvent.xml to add the requested sentence to AdverseEvent.status.comment. That commit is an ancestor of the current worker HEAD.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in the current build configuration: source/fhir.ini lists AdverseEvent in active resource/build-scope entries, maps adverseevent=AdverseEvent, marks AdverseEvent normative, and records FMG approval. The same current comment appears in source/adverseevent/adverseevent-event-mapping-exceptions.xml. Related FHIR-34200 asked for broader status clarification/redesign but was Resolved - No Change, supporting no broader status-model edit here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative AdverseEvent StructureDefinition already includes the exact approved clarification, and searched Jira, Zulip, Confluence, source, and git evidence did not reveal a later reversal or missing in-scope source location.
